selected_authority.authority_rule: current/post/next artifacts and Streaming manifest; authoritative_generation.json exclusively promotes NEXT; outer index only references these credentials

delta_n.rule: source[0:8048] in original interval order; no interpolation

vx.rule: positive float64 zero per cell; all 8048 screens
vx.hash_scope: future raw file bytes; per-screen content checked by existing sha256_array

vy.rule: positive float64 zero per cell; all 8048 screens
vy.hash_scope: future raw file bytes; per-screen content checked by existing sha256_array

coordinates.rule: same array indices; no physical translation/resampling; optical axes remain make_axes axes

pre0.initialization_receipt: NEW_GLUE_DESIGNED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: PRE0_READY bound to validated Streaming manifest/current_content_sha256 and every file/field hash; incomplete root never discoverable as ready

e5_1_candidate.schedule_rule: slice full.z_edges[:8049], full.dz_intervals[:8048], full.intervals[:8048]; instantiate existing LongitudinalSchedule; pass to propagate_one_pulse; do not rebuild at endpoint
e5_1_candidate.reference: isolated serial Batch using existing HR4C evolve_hr4_full_z; full PRE velocities carried through POST
e5_1_candidate.candidate: existing Streaming CURRENT/POST/NEXT with designed outer glue
e5_1_candidate.domain_end_reason: ceil((8045+1)/8)*8=8048; covers qualification endpoint plus full blocks; normal claim rejects partial tail

resource_model.retention: NO_DELETION; reference first then candidate; all roots and scientific arrays retained
resource_model.e5_2_single_stream_formula: (3*N-1+C)*G + 6*N*F + N*O + F_full + allowances = (5*N-1+C)*G + N*O + F_full + allowances
resource_model.e5_2_dual_track_formula: (12*N-4+C)*G + 2*N*O + F_full + allowances; C counts additional full-generation copies across both tracks

cross_pulse.current_binding: copy all three fields from validated predecessor current_fields AFTER promotion; no hardlink/symlink; verify each array hash and source receipt
cross_pulse.pulse_index: 0..N-1; derived from ready lineage; no advance from intent/index alone
cross_pulse.state_generation: opaque Streaming current_generation/next_generation strings; not HR4D 2p
cross_pulse.restart_epoch: separate allocation/restart number; no physical advance
cross_pulse.source_generation: predecessor promotion authoritative_generation; PRE0 names frozen E1B
cross_pulse.outer_index: references only; recover from existing promotion and ready receipts
cross_pulse.same_pulse_pre: CURRENT identity pinned until optical complete and full barrier; never read fresh NEXT
cross_pulse.post: delta_n_pre + authoritative HR3 increment; velocities unchanged
cross_pulse.hydro: enqueue each durable POST immediately under existing bounded backpressure; not full POST gate
cross_pulse.terminal: N optical, N logical POST, N-1 hydro; final hook commits POST without enqueue; new read-only terminal receipt, no final NEXT/promotion

exact.array_hash: existing hr4e_timestep.sha256_array: dtype + NUL + canonical JSON shape + NUL + C-order bytes; not file-byte hash
exact.restart: one planned allocation boundary after p=0 promotion; no fault injection; old writers quiescent; recover p=1 using predecessor pointer

qualification_status: existing mechanisms only; new cross-pulse and final mode not qualified

superseded.correction: HR4C production replacement and all-POST-before-hydro withdrawn by user; historical Git/ZIP preserved

status_scope: E5-0 preparation contract only; existing status is the authoritative e5_0_status equivalent

acceptance_record.scope: design/preparation only; no implementation or execution authorization
